result.summary: The page is largely well-composed with no broken layouts, overlapping text, or missing assets. Two minor cosmetic/consistency issues stand out: inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) buttons between restaurant cards, and low-contrast placeholder text in the search field. Horizontal carousel clipping and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card appears as a bare white outline directly on the photo, while the same button on the pizza card below sits inside a dark circular scrim. This inconsistent treatment makes the first heart harder to see and looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background (or consistent scrim) behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards for uniform appearance and reliable contrast over any image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., to a mid-gray around #6B7280) so it meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the input background.
